entities.summary: Andrzej Jerzy Zglejszewski (Polish: [ˈandʐɛj ˈjɛʐɨ zɡlɛjˈʂɛfskʲi] is a Polish-born Catholic prelate who has served as an auxiliary bishop for the Diocese of Rockville Centre in New York since 2014.
